Batman - The Video Game.name: Batman: The Video Game
Batman - The Video Game.summary: Batman: The Video Game is a 1990 action video game developed and published by Sunsoft for the Game Boy. Based on the DC Comics superhero Batman, it is inspired by the Warner Bros.'s 1989 film of the same name.

Spot - Cool Adventure.name: Spot: The Cool Adventure
Spot - Cool Adventure.summary: Another game based on the adventures of 7-UP's mascot, Spot. Known in Europe as McDonaldland.
